news.title: Welcome back: Twins reunite with veteran RHP Gray on two-year deal
news.summary: The Twins have signed free agent right-hander Sonny Gray to a two-year contract, the team announced. The deal is for $55 million and includes an opt-out after the first season, sources told ESPN's Jef...

news.title: Playing hardball: Commish says MLB owners won't OK deal without cap as lockout looms
news.summary: Commissioner Rob Manfred said owners will not accept any deal without a salary cap, leaving MLB on track for a lockout that could threaten the 2027 season.

news.title: Sources: Mets considered Skubal front-runner as teams ramp up pursuit of ace lefty
news.summary: Tarik Skubal has met with multiple teams that are expected to pursue him, but the Mets are considered the favorite to land the star pitcher, sources told ESPN.

news.title: MLB expects $4B Angels sale to Kroenke to close in January
news.summary: Major League Baseball expects the proposed sale of the Los Angeles Angels to Kroenke Sports and Entertainment at a $4 billion evaluation to take place in January.

news.title: Mariners acquire 3B Garcia from Royals in six-player trade
news.summary: The Royals have traded third baseman Maikel Garcia to the Mariners in exchange for right-hander Bryce Miller as part of a six-player trade.

news.title: Angels acquire infielder Jace Jung from Tigers for cash
news.summary: The Angels acquired infielder Jace Jung from the Tigers for cash on Wednesday, giving the 2022 first-round draft pick a fresh start.
